n_9476766db0ad5707.name: Configure the collection and sheet
n_9476766db0ad5707.source: export default function config({url,spreadsheetId,sheetName}){if(typeof url!=='string'||!/^https:\/\/[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9.-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?(?:\/[a-zA-Z0-9._~!$&'()*+,;=:@%/-]*)?$/.test(url)||url.includes('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure the HTTPS public Squarespace collection URL without query parameters');if(typeof spreadsheetId!=='string'||!spreadsheetId.trim()||spreadsheetId.startsWith('YOUR_')||typeof sheetName!=='string'||!sheetName.trim()||/[!\r\n]/.test(sheetName))throw Error('Configure the spreadsheet and sheet');const q="'"+sheetName.replace(/'/g,"''")+"'";return{url,spreadsheetId,sheetName,range:q+'!A:ZZZ'}}

n_815cd691d682da13.name: Collect collection pages
n_815cd691d682da13.source: export default function collect({previous,response}){const s=previous??{items:[],offset:'',seen:[],started:false};if(!s.started)return{state:{...s,started:true},more:true,offset:'',items:[]};if(!response||typeof response!=='object'||!Array.isArray(response.items)||!response.pagination||typeof response.pagination.nextPage!=='boolean')throw Error('Invalid Squarespace collection page');const items=[...s.items,...response.items],next=response.pagination.nextPage;if(!next)return{state:{...s,items},more:false,offset:'',items};const value=response.pagination.nextPageOffset;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(value)||value<0||s.seen.includes(value))throw Error('Invalid or repeated Squarespace offset');return{state:{...s,items,offset:String(value),seen:[...s.seen,value]},more:true,offset:String(value),items:[]}}

n_af3b916217b874ac.name: Match articles to rows
n_af3b916217b874ac.source: export default function plan({items,values,sheetName}){if(!Array.isArray(items)||!Array.isArray(values)||!values.length||!Array.isArray(values[0]))throw Error('The sheet needs headers');const h=values[0],fields=['id','tags','title','urlId','addedOn','fullUrl','assetUrl','publishOn','categories'];if(fields.some(x=>h.indexOf(x)<0||h.indexOf(x)!==h.lastIndexOf(x)))throw Error('The sheet needs unique required headers');const indexes=Object.fromEntries(fields.map(x=>[x,h.indexOf(x)])),existing=new Map();for(let i=1;i<values.length;i++){let row=values[i];if(!Array.isArray(row))throw Error('Invalid sheet row');let id=row[indexes.id];if(id===null||id===undefined||id==='')continue;if(typeof id!=='string'||existing.has(id))throw Error('Duplicate or invalid sheet ID');existing.set(id,{index:i+1,raw:row})}const seen=new Set(),date=v=>{if((typeof v!=='number'&&typeof v!=='string')||v===''||!Number.isFinite(new Date(v).getTime()))throw Error('Invalid collection date');return new Date(v).toISOString().slice(0,10)},tasks=[];let appendIndex=values.length+1;for(const item of items){if(!item||typeof item.id!=='string'||!item.id||seen.has(item.id))throw Error('Invalid or duplicate collection ID');seen.add(item.id);for(const key of ['title','urlId','fullUrl'])if(typeof item[key]!=='string')throw Error('Missing collection field');for(const key of ['tags','categories'])if(!Array.isArray(item[key])||item[key].some(x=>typeof x!=='string'))throw Error('Invalid collection tags');if(item.assetUrl!=null&&typeof item.assetUrl!=='string')throw Error('Invalid image URL');const fieldsValue={id:item.id,tags:item.tags.join(', '),title:item.title,urlId:item.urlId,addedOn:date(item.addedOn),fullUrl:item.fullUrl,assetUrl:item.assetUrl??'',publishOn:date(item.publishOn),categories:item.categories.join(', ')},target=existing.get(item.id)??{index:appendIndex++,raw:[]};tasks.push({id:item.id,index:target.index,raw:target.raw,indexes,fieldsValue})}return{tasks,sheetName}}

n_65f50cfd572ae64b.name: Select the next article
n_65f50cfd572ae64b.source: export default function next({tasks,previous,confirmation,sheetName}){const s=previous??{index:0,waiting:false,pageId:null};if(s.waiting){if(confirmation!==9)throw Error('Sheet update not fully confirmed');s.index++;s.waiting=false}s.pageId=null;if(s.index>=tasks.length)return{state:s,more:false,item:{},range:"'unused'!A1:ZZZ1"};const item=tasks[s.index];if(!item||!Number.isSafeInteger(item.index)||item.index<2)throw Error('Invalid sheet task');const q="'"+sheetName.replace(/'/g,"''")+"'";return{state:{...s,waiting:true,pageId:item.id},more:true,item,range:q+'!A'+item.index+':ZZZ'+item.index}}

n_ef8b90db30936512.name: Prepare the article cells
n_ef8b90db30936512.source: export default function update({item,checked,sheetName}){if(!Array.isArray(checked)||checked.length>1||JSON.stringify(checked[0]??[])!==JSON.stringify(item.raw))throw Error('Sheet row changed since reading');const q="'"+sheetName.replace(/'/g,"''")+"'",col=n=>{let x=n+1,s='';while(x){x--;s=String.fromCharCode(65+x%26)+s;x=Math.floor(x/26)}return s};return{data:Object.entries(item.fieldsValue).map(([key,v])=>({range:q+'!'+col(item.indexes[key])+item.index,values:[[v]]}))}}
